snippet.title: New QBIX Game | Chef Express
snippet.description:
Callin' all the chefs! Even if the kitchen is not your usual playground, the newest addition to the QBIX lineup - Chef Express - will make you a top-tier cook. Chop, stir, fry, and taste every challenge of the game! 

Learn more about QBIX at: https://inowize.com/qbix/

QBIX is an unattended immersive game room manufactured by Inowize, that offers a great range of fun and multi-sensory games in a 13x13 ft space, with 5D effects like wind blasts and a motion floor.
